liveNote: L3 attempt documented in results/f1-live-reproduction.txt. The in-cluster manager (v0.8.0-0c00546d, OLDER than the PR base a747e804) reproduces a restartPolicy-representation failure: it stores restartPolicy as an OBJECT in the RoleInstanceSet template, the RoleInstance CRD requires a STRING, so RoleInstance creation is rejected (FailedCreate, 0 pods). This confirms the code area has live round-trip problems, but is NOT cleanly attributable to the PR-base code (the in-cluster build predates a747e804) and a PR-manager deployment was NOT safe on this shared cluster (blast radius includes default/nginx-cluster, a 23-day-old non-test RBG). The PR's actual claim — revision-hash stability via string preservation — is proven at the unit layer (F1 contract + bite check).
